notes.title: Update announcement at 14:30 on November 6
notes.notes:
Dear general Yulong

Thank you for your love and support for "Yulong in the heaven balanced national war"! In order to bring you a better experience of the game, we will update "matchless in the world" at 14:30 on November 6 (Wednesday), during which players will not be able to enter the game for 10-20 minutes! We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to you!

Update time: 14:30, Wednesday, November 6 (10-20 minutes can't experience the game)

Maintenance scope: unparalleled in the world

I. adjustment of system mall
1. Full court frost - 7 days, snow unicorn - 7 days, Saint Xianlin - 7 days will be sold at a discount of 3.75%
2. Add Manting frost for - 30 days, snow Unicorn for - 30 days and Saint Xianlin for - 30 days
3. Head portrait - young general, head portrait - Xiashi are off the shelf in the mall. Now you can get it by opening the Dragon lucky gift
4. Weapons fashion - children's interesting weapons are off the shelves in the mall
5. Yulong members (30 days) will be sold at a discount of 8.3%
6. Proof of killing enemies will be sold at a discount of 20%
7. Xiaofei shoes, changing dart order and washing marrow Scripture are off the shelves in the mall. Now you can buy them from the silver binding page of the carry on store
8. The energy pill, vitality water, huanlinglu, red rose, blue Witch and King's mark are off the shelves in the mall. Now you can buy them in separate pages from the silver in your store. The energy pill is limited to 2 per week
9. Repentance tears will be sold at 20% discount
10. The king orders to get off the shelves in the mall
11. Readjust the contents of the reward pool and the probability of related props; the probability has been publicized on the description of props
12. Increase the reward content of some gift packages, and increase the corresponding sales price (battle horse soul breaking heart bag, battle wing feather feather heart bag, battle horse advanced heart bag). Battle wing advanced package, battle horse advanced package, battle wing advanced package, refining package, forging package, silver strapping supply package)

II. System play optimization
1. [Loulan underground palace] a gift package for famous generals. The starting price is 2000. There is a certain chance to open a double orange famous general
2. [family] the clan head joins the salary; after the family prosperity reaches a certain level, a certain amount of silver can be obtained every week
3. [lucky bag] update the lucky bag reward content in November

III. other system optimization
1. Fix the bug obtained by the team copy title
2. The attribute of character fashion - heart searching has been increased from 2% to 3.8%. The fashion is mainly produced by seal shops
3. Increased the selling price of some items (secret treasure, rebirth Qiling, rebirth Yiling, invincible escort vehicle order, escort order, changing escort order, King's mark, Zhanqi)
4. Optimize the ranking of National Guard Temple
5. Fashion synthesis: reduce the cost of fragment synthesis of Manting frost, snow unicorn and Saint Xianlin
